title: Meta新应用登顶：亚马逊已切断访问，购物代理还能用吗
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This app has got a couple of very good use cases to serve as personal agents, which is what they're pitching for.
segments.zh: 这款应用有几个很好的使用场景，可以作为个人代理，这正是他们宣传的卖点。

segments.en: So I'll mention, you know, just if you want discount codes for any brand that you're shopping on the internet,
segments.zh: 比如，如果你想在网上购物时获得任何品牌的折扣码，

segments.en: like you look for discount codes through Google searches and all that, just ask a muse a question, and it will give you the best discount codes.
segments.zh: 就像你通过谷歌搜索等方式寻找折扣码一样，只需向Muse提问，它就会给你最好的折扣码。

segments.en: But do the discount codes work? Because I asked Google the same thing, and Google will give me a whole bunch of discount codes and when you apply it, it says, nope, nope.
segments.zh: 但这些折扣码能用吗？因为我问过谷歌同样的问题，谷歌会给我一大堆折扣码，但当你应用时，它却说不行，不行。

segments.en: It does for the most part. And you bring up a very good point.
segments.zh: 大部分情况下确实能用。你提出了一个很好的观点。

segments.en: So the challenge for this is, in theory, it scrapes all the best information from the internet.
segments.zh: 所以这里的挑战在于，理论上它会从互联网上抓取所有最好的信息。

segments.en: But what if a retailer like Amazon blocks you or it doesn't give you the most up-to-date information, and that's where the agent may not work as desired
segments.zh: 但如果像亚马逊这样的零售商阻止你，或者不给你最新的信息，那么代理可能就无法按预期工作。

segments.en: because it doesn't have that latest information, not because it can't, but because, you know, the retailers who own the inventory
segments.zh: 因为它没有最新信息，不是因为它不能，而是因为拥有库存的零售商

segments.en: don't want it to be integrated, you know, with what they're doing.
segments.zh: 不希望它被整合到他们正在做的事情中。

segments.en: And so in this case, Amazon probably will end up launching their own agent, but I would expect that agent to work in conjunction
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，亚马逊最终可能会推出自己的代理，但我预计那个代理会与

segments.en: with what meta is doing because there will be a lot of agent to agent traffic and shopping where the human user is completely gone.
segments.zh: Meta的布局，因为未来会有大量代理间流量和购物，人类用户完全不在场。

segments.en: It's your agent working with that retailers agent and doing the transaction.
segments.zh: 你的代理与零售商的代理协作完成交易。
